# Understand and account for media

Run `node node_modules/@vitris/kernel/bin/vitris-prepare-media.js --site .`. It creates an inventory and HTML contact sheet without discarding prior decisions.

Open the contact sheet in a browser, inspect it in batches, and open candidates at full size. Identify actual subjects, projects, people, illustrations, text baked into images, transparency, duplicate crops, and usable dimensions. Do not trust alt text as visual classification.

Account for each image as use, retain, duplicate, or exclude with a specific reason. Keep important project collections available for interior pages; the shortlist can expand. Selected assets need actual visual inspection and intended route placements. If a signature asset appears in the source but is absent locally, recover it before passing; record unresolved acquisition separately.

Keep onboarding/brief.json, onboarding/raw, and media/harvest immutable after acquisition. Save recovered originals under media/recovered and derived/cropped variants separately. Add recovered assets and source mappings to the inventory without rewriting capture evidence. Inventory placements are proposed routes; the storyboard establishes final route/section placement.

Choose treatments that fit the material: contain device mockups and diagrams; crop photography around its subject; avoid turning full illustrations into tiny icons. Don't force an image-count quota or use all assets for its own sake.
